panels.prose_en: Saint Mirren International University stood proud among the top five most prestigious academic institutions on the globe. From the outside, it was a breathtaking monument of power and wealth—gleaming glass skyscrapers piercing the heavens, luxury sports cars lining private marble lanes, and the scions of the global elite walking the corridors in immaculate, gold-crested blazers.
panels.prose_hi: Duniya ke top 5 sabse bade aur aalishaan sansthano mein se ek—Saint Mirren International University. Bahar se dekhne par yeh jagah be-hisaab daulat aur shaan-o-shaukat ka kisi sapne jaisa aalishaan mahal nazar aati thi—unche-unche kaanch ke skyscrapers aasmaan ko cheerte hue, chamakti hui luxury sports cars private marble lanes par khadi, aur duniya bhar ke arabpati gharano ke bachche apne be-daag, golden academy blazers mein ghoomte the.

panels.prose_en: Yet beneath this glittering veneer of prestige lay a rotten, cruel reality. Beyond the prying eyes of the public, within the academy’s secluded courtyards and shadowed corridors, the bullying rate exceeded sixty percent. For ordinary scholarship students born without wealth or pedigree, there was no law. There was only survival.
panels.prose_hi: Lekin is chamak-dhamak aur rutbe ke parde ke peeche ek behad ghinauna aur khaufnaak sach chupa hua tha. Aam janta ki nigaahon se door, academy ke andhere kono mein bullying rate 60% se bhi zyada badh chuka tha. Aam scholarship students ke liye, jo bina kisi daulat ya unche khandan ke aaye the, yahan koi qanoon nahi tha. Yahan sirf zillat thi ya be-reham zulm.

bubbles.speaker: Lead Bully
bubbles.text: Hey, beggar! Did I give you permission to look up? Keep your damn head on the ground where it belongs!

bubbles.speaker: Second Bully
bubbles.text: He's tough, I'll give him that. Maybe we need to break a couple more ribs before he learns his place.

panels.prose_en: On the deserted concrete rooftop of the academy's northern tower, cold autumn rain fell in torrential sheets. Seventeen-year-old Ha-Jun Kang lay collapsed on the puddle-soaked ground. His navy uniform blazer was torn and coated in grime, his white shirt stained with dirt and blood. With every ragged breath, fresh crimson blood dripped from his split lower lip, dissolving into the rain puddles beneath him. Towering over his battered body were two academy seniors, their fists bruised from violence and their smirking faces dripping with contempt.
panels.prose_hi: Academy ke northern tower ki ek sunsaan, thandi concrete chhat par toofani baarish ka keher baras raha tha. Satra saal ka Ha-Jun Kang keechad aur paani se bhare farsh par gira pada tha. Uska navy academy blazer phat chuka tha, safed shirt par mitti aur khoon laga tha. Har kaanpti hui saans ke saath, uske phate hue nichle honth se taaza laal khoon behkar paani ke gaddhon mein ghul raha tha. Uske theek upar academy ke do senior bullies khade the, jinki mutthiyan maarte-maarte laal ho chuki thi aur chehron par ghamand aur darindgi bhari muskaan thi.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun clenched his trembling hands against the cold concrete. Pain flared through his ribs like white-hot needles, but his dark brown eyes burned with silent, unyielding defiance. He refused to beg. He refused to give them the tears they craved.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne thande farsh par apni kaanpti hui mutthiyan bheenchi. Uski tooti hui pasliyon mein aag ki tarah dard uth raha tha, lekin uski gehri bhoori aankhon mein chup-chap, na jhukne wali aag jal rahi thi. Usne haath jodkar maafi maangne se inkaar kar diya. Usne wo aansu bahane se inkaar kar diya jiske liye yeh bullies tadap rahe the.

bubbles.speaker: Kuro
bubbles.text: Tsk... So this is the sole surviving bloodline of our Sovereign? Being crushed by mere human insects... I suppose I have no choice but to intervene.

panels.prose_en: High above the cruelty, perched atop the rusted black iron perimeter railing, an uninvited spectator watched. It was a creature that defied reason—a raven-like demonic familiar cloaked in sleek, midnight-purple feathers that seemed to swallow the light. Two small, curved obsidian horns jutted from its crown, and twin crimson eyes gleamed with ancient intelligence. The creature, Kuro, tilted its head, observing Ha-Jun with a low, guttural murmur.
panels.prose_hi: Is saare zulm ke upar, chhat ki unchi lohe ki zang-lagi railing par baitha ek anjaan mehmaan sab dekh raha tha. Woh ek aisi makhlooq thi jo kudrat ke har qanoon ko चुनौती de rahi thi—ek shaitani kaawa-tota familiar jiske kaale par aadhi raat ki baingani roshni se chamak rahe the. Sar par do nanhe se teekhe seeng the, aur uski dono laal aankhon mein sadiyon purana shaitani dimaagh jhalak raha tha. Us makhlooq, Kuro, ne apna sar tirchha kiya aur dheemi ghurrahat ke saath dekha.

bubbles.speaker: Bully 1
bubbles.text: Ugh... w-what is this...?! Why is my head spinning...?!

bubbles.speaker: Bully 2
bubbles.text: M-My hands... I can't breathe... Run! There's something demonic about this place!

panels.prose_en: Kuro gently unfurled its obsidian wings. An invisible, dark-violet hex pulsed outward across the rain-slicked roof. It moved like a whisper in the wind, rippling through the falling raindrops. In an instant, the lead bully gasped for air as a terrifying sensation of suffocating pressure clamped down around his chest. The second boy's knees buckled violently. Panic overtook their cruelty, and both boys stumbled backward toward the rooftop stairwell in blind terror, their frantic footsteps echoing away down the staircase.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne apne baingani paron ko halka sa phailaya. Palak jhapakte hi ek adrishya dark-violet hex lehar chhat par toot padi. Yeh toofani baarish ki boondon ko cheerte hue dono ladkon ke jism mein dhal gayi. Ek hi pal mein lead bully ka dam ghutne laga. Doosre ladke ke ghutne jawab de gaye aur jism se jaan nikalne lagi. Unki darindgi dehshat mein badal gayi, aur dono bullies seedhiyon ke darwaze ki taraf dum daba kar bhaag nikle.

panels.prose_en: Left alone on the rooftop, Ha-Jun weakly pushed himself up with trembling arms. Rainwater dripped from his soaked fringe, stinging his swollen cheekbone. As he raised his head, his gaze locked directly with the mysterious creature on the railing. Violet wisps of mana swirled around its talons. The bird’s glowing red eyes peered straight into the depths of Ha-Jun's soul.
panels.prose_hi: Chhat par akele bache Ha-Jun ne kaanpte hue haathon ke bal khud ko upar uthaya. Uske bheege hue baalon se paani tapak raha tha, zakhmi gaal par jalan ho rahi thi. Jaise hi usne sar uthaya, uski nigahein railing par baithe us ajeeb parinde se ja mili. Uski taangon ke ird-gird baingani mana ke chhalle ghoom rahe the. Uski laal chamakti aankhein Ha-Jun ki rooh ke andar tak jhaank rahi thi.

panels.prose_en: The creature did not answer with words. In a sudden, blinding flash, Kuro dissolved into a vortex of swirling dark-violet miasma and ethereal embers. Within the span of a single heartbeat, the beast vanished completely into the stormy sky. On the iron railing where its talons had gripped, only one thing remained: a single demonic feather—glossy obsidian with an iridescent violet sheen. A sudden, violent gust of wind swept the feather into the air. It floated gently downward, landing onto the wet concrete a few paces in front of Ha-Jun, radiating an eerie neon-violet luminescence.
panels.prose_hi: Parinde ne lafzon mein koi jawab nahi diya. Achanak, ek blinding baingani dhuen aur aag ki chingaariyon ke bawandar mein Kuro hawa mein fanaa ho gaya. Lohe ki railing par jahan uske panje the, wahan sirf ek cheez chhoot gayi: ek akela shaitani pankh—glossy obsidian black reshey jinpar baingani chamak thi. Hawa ke ek tez toofani jhonke ne us pankh ko railing se uda diya. Wo dheere se neeche aaya aur Ha-Jun se kuch kadam aage farsh par gir gaya, jiski nok se neon-violet roshni nikal rahi thi.

panels.prose_en: ‘Why does it... feel warm?’ Despite the biting cold and the exhaustion threatening to pull him into darkness, an inexplicable instinct tugged at Ha-Jun’s chest. A primal whisper inside his blood commanded him: Touch it. Claim what was stolen. Ignoring the screaming pain in his bruised muscles, Ha-Jun dragged himself across the puddles on scraping knees. Inch by inch, he reached out his battered, trembling right hand. His cold fingers brushed against the obsidian barbules.
panels.prose_hi: ‘Yeh pankh... itna garam kyu lag raha hai?’ Jamane wali thand aur behoshi ke bawajood, Ha-Jun ke seene mein ek ajeeb sa khinchaav hua. Uski ragon ke andar se ek aadi aadesh gunja: Ise chhoo. Apna haq le. Apne jism ke tod dene wale dard ko bhoolkar, Ha-Jun ghutno ke bal paani mein rengte hue aage badha. Inch-dar-inch, usne apna kaanpta hua zakhmi haath aage kiya. Uski thandi ungliyon ne us kaale pankh ko chhoo liya.

panels.prose_en: The moment his skin made contact, a blinding shockwave exploded outward across the rooftop! A mechanical, celestial chime rang directly inside Ha-Jun's consciousness. Violent arcs of violet lightning erupted along his forearm, tearing through the sleeve of his blazer. Prismatic dark fire coiled around his wrist and knuckles, etching the ethereal silhouette of a jagged, demonic gauntlet onto his flesh. 'Aaargh...!' Ha-Jun gasped as an unfathomable torrent of primordial power rushed into his veins, burning away the cold, the weakness, and the despair. His heartbeat hammered like the war drums of an ancient emperor waking from an eon of sleep. In the pouring rain of Saint Mirren Academy, the weak scholarship student died. The Demon Sovereign had opened his eyes.
panels.prose_hi: Chhoote hi, chhat par ek prachand supernatural shockwave phoot padi! Ek thandi, mechanical aakashvani Ha-Jun ke dimaagh mein goonji: [SOVEREIGN BLOODLINE AWAKENING INITIATED: 1% SYNCHRONIZATION]. Uske baazu par baingani bijli ka tufan phoot pada, jisne blazer ki aasteen ko jala diya. Kaali aag uski kalai aur knuckles par liptne lagi, aur uski khaal par ek shaitani gauntlet ka aakaar ban gaya. 'Aaargh...!' Ha-Jun ki cheekh nikal gayi jab sadiyon purana shaitani mana uski ragon mein ubalne laga, jisne thand, dard aur bebasie ko jala kar raakh kar diya. Saint Mirren Academy ki toofani baarish mein wo lachaar scholarship student mar chuka tha. Demon Sovereign ne apni aankhein khol di thi.
